args.text: Pacing: I've been at war with Saba for many turns and have a 40k army next to the border, but no battle has opened yet. Every turn starts with a 'Choose production' prompt for some city, even right after I used Advisor builds, so I keep spending turns on queues instead of fighting. I never got into an RTS battle this session, so I couldn't test deploy, orders, workers or sieges.

thought: I'm running out of steps without a battle. Recording the pacing problem.

name: tap
thought: Turning on 'Always' advisor builds so production prompts stop eating my turns.

name: done

args.summary: This session covered save and load, the glossary index, era goals, naval transport (boarding, sailing and landing musketeers) and advisor builds. Turning on Always advisor builds stopped the production prompts and brought back End Turn. I never got into an RTS battle, even after many turns at war with Saba with a big army near its border. So I could not test deploy, orders, workers or sieges. Pacing is the main problem: production prompts kept eating turns, and the war never produced a fight. Other notes: pinch zoom moved very little, and tapping a people's name opened its glossary entry, not its diplomacy card.

thought: Out of steps. The Always option cleared the prompts, but I never got a battle.
